title: dedicated-autoscaler-burst-throughput-fallback-and-util-reporting
author: Aisha Kumar
description: Summary: Add a graceful throughput-fallback policy for Dedicated fleets when burst capacity is exhausted and improve utilization reporting and metrics for downstream billing and SLOs. Motivation: customers running Dedicated capacity reported intermittent tail latency when transient burst demand exceeded token-bucket burst allowances. Previously the autoscaler either rejected requests or waited for capacity which caused high P95/P99 latency or failed requests under tight SLAs. This PR introduces a configurable 'burst_fallback_policy' that allows the serving runtime to route excess burst requests to a best-fit fallback path (short-lived ephemeral spillover nodes, reduced-quantization model variants, or queued micro-batches) while preserving throughput guarantees for pinned capacity. Changes: 1) Autoscaler core: new BurstFallbackManager that evaluates burst windows, available ephemeral slots and fallback model compatibility, and triggers fallback decisions based on policy thresholds. 2) Tokenbucket & smoothing: expose internal smoothing state to reporting pipeline and add new metrics (dedicated.autoscaler.burst_fallback.count, dedicated.autoscaler.fallback_latency_ms, dedicated.autoscaler.tokenbucket.fill_ratio) for visibility. 3) Reporting: extend utilization reporting to include fallback usage, ephemeral node counts and per-fleet fallback rate; update billing-related exports to tag fallback usage separately. 4) Config: add fleet config schema additions: burst_fallback_policy (enum: reject|queue|ephemeral|model_variant) and fallback_capacity_thresholds. 5) Safety: implement circuit-breaker and backoff loop to avoid infinite fallback churn, plus canary rollout flags. 6) Tests & e2e: unit tests for decision logic, integration harness changes for ephemeral nodes, and a new end-to-end perf test exercising fallback under synthetic burst patterns. 7) Docs & Console: API docs update and console dashboard tiles for fallback metrics and per-route fallback traces. Rollout plan: behind feature flag, staged canary across 5% fleets, monitor fallback rate and P99 latency, then 25% and full rollout. Related: ENG-5421 for incident triage, SUP-1342 customer support ticket. Impact: improves availability during transient surges, reduces failed requests while preserving main capacity SLOs.
